info.name: Multi-Vendor Marketplace - DELIVERY PARTNER
info.description: Delivery partner vertical: partner auth, partner self-service (availability/location/vehicle), admin-driven partner onboarding, delivery assignment, delivery zones, delivery issues and delivery tracking.

item.name: Delivery Partner Auth
item.description: Delivery partner login/session endpoints (mounted at /auth/delivery via auth.routes.ts).

item.name: Admin Auth (for admin-gated endpoints)
item.description: Partner onboarding, delivery assignment and delivery zones are admin-only — log in here first to populate {{adminToken}}.

item.name: Delivery Partners (Admin)
item.description: Delivery partner account onboarding/lifecycle — admin only.

item.name: Delivery Partners (Self-Service)
item.description: The owning partner (self) can also be a location-scoped admin — dual-actor endpoints. Defaults to {{deliveryToken}}; swap to {{adminToken}} to test the admin path.

item.name: Delivery Assignment (Admin)
item.description: Order-to-partner assignment — admin only (mounted at /delivery via deliveryAssignment.routes.ts).

request.description: Provide either a polygon, or centerLatitude/centerLongitude/radius.
Raised by whichever party experienced it: CUSTOMER, VENDOR or DELIVERY_PARTNER.
Resolving/closing an issue is an ops/support action — admin-only.

item.name: Deliveries
item.description: Delivery-leg tracking, separate from the Order resource.
